mapper.update: UPDATE people_link_request SET status = #{status}, task_id = #{taskId}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM people_link_request WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM people_link_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND target_people_id = #{peopleId} AND kind = 'DEMOGRAPHIC' AND status = 'OPEN' AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM people_link_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND kind = 'LINK' AND status = 'OPEN' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM people_link_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('OPEN', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY gmt_created DESC LIMIT 20
